t: What Does The Name Ameha Mean?
s: It belongs to the same semantic field as Amharic Amha (“he has shown mercy”), Amhadu/Amhad, and the theophoric compound Amha-Selassie (“mercy of the Trinity”). In Tigrinya, parallel forms include Ameha and Amha, while in Oromo contexts the name can appear alongside conceptually similar virtue names like Faya or Fayisa (“deliverance”), though these are linguistically distinct.
